result.title: MinPair: Measured Minimal Pairs for Fine-Grained Control in Text-to-Motion Generation
result.summary: Text-to-motion generation has made great progress in capturing what action to perform, yet it remains limited in controlling how that action is executed. For example, when only the height word of a kick request changes, none of the tested state-of-the-art methods reaches all three of knee, waist and head height. The other words of a caption usually imply an attribute such as height, so neither the training loss nor the standard metrics require a model to use the word that states it. A model has to use this word only when it alone separates two otherwise identical captions. We introduce MinPair, which creates such caption pairs from real motion clips. It starts from rule-based motion descriptors that measure the 3D body motion of each clip. From these descriptors a language model writes MinPair captions, timed body-part captions that say how each body part moves. The same descriptors show in which attributes two clips of the same action differ. A measured minimal pair joins the true caption of one clip with an altered copy in which only one attribute takes the value measured in the other clip. A contrastive pair loss then requires a diffusion denoiser to reconstruct the clip more accurately from its true caption than from the altered copy. Training needs no synthetic motion and inference stays unchanged. Control is tested on 22 target tasks and on caption edits that each change one attribute. MinPair captions alone help motions reach their targets and improve the standard metrics M2M, R@3 and FID, yet a model trained on them still ignores most single-word edits. The pair loss raises the share of followed template edits from 11% to 60%, while the standard metrics do not improve further. With body-part captions, MinPair reaches more targets than state-of-the-art methods that were trained on up to 99 times more motion data.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MinPair：从规则化 3D 运动描述符生成带时序部位信息的高细粒度 caption，并构造只改一个属性的「测量最小对」，配合对比式 pair loss 要求扩散去噪器用真 caption 比用改动副本更准确地重建动作，在 22 个目标任务与单词编辑上评估细粒度控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 最小对构造加对比损失可用来迫使模型依赖单一条件词，其「只有该词能区分才需使用该词」的监督思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配的训练设计；但任务为动作生成，与内部推理状态无直接关联。
